title: The description hint names the other locations and disappears when the saved value is typed back
custom_preconds:
• A Part Library entry stocked at this location and exactly one other (e.g. 334-1584 at Heavy Duty and Lethbridge).
  • Parts > Part Library > the entry > pencil (Edit Library Part).
custom_steps:
1. Add one character to the end of Description (do not Save).
  2. Delete that character so the value equals the saved one again.
  3. Add spaces before and after the saved description.
  4. Close with the X.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • Under Description: "This also changes the description at 1 other location." ("at {n} other locations." when more than one).

Step 2:

  • The hint disappears.

Step 3:

  • No hint (outer spaces are not a change).

Step 4:

  • Nothing saved; the entry keeps its description.
